title: Handoff Strategy Lift — 1x1 Prep (Marcus Lee)
content:
Goal: align AE+CSM for a short, tactical 'lift' conversation to re-establish exec sponsorship, surface friction, and lock actions that reduce renewal risk.

Context (one-liners):
- Account: North Ridge Logistics — mid-market, logistics SaaS. ARR ~ $420k (annualized), renewal July 2025.
- Primary contacts: 
  - Procurement/Finance: Dana Morales (renewal owner)
  - Product/ML lead: Kenji Ito (power user, concerned about latency spikes)
  - TPM / integration: Lara Voss (on-prem install lead)
- Why this meeting: AE needs to handoff operational concerns to CSM and confirm a remediation path for latency + training gaps. We want a 90-day plan that shows measurable impact.

Snapshot metrics to have ready (pull latest in meeting):
- Monthly token consumption: ~1.1B tokens/month (gen + chat). 3% MoM growth.
- 95th pct latency (prod model): 620ms — above our SLO (450ms).
- Incidents in last 30d: 2 partial degradations linked to autoscaler config (SRE ticket CS-1227).
- Model variant: running rwd-open-1b-quant (last updated 2024-11-02).
- Cost / month estimate: ~$26k (hosted) — customer asked for cost review last Q.

Prioritize these outcomes (ranked):
1) Secure alignment on 90-day remediation milestones and owners (must include SRE + AE + CSM).
2) Get explicit approval for a short dedicated capacity trial (4 weeks) to validate latency fix.
3) Book an exec touchpoint (Dana + VP Eng) for end-of-trial review.

Agenda (20–25 min):
- 0:00–02:00 quick status (what changed since last touch)
- 02:00–07:00 crystallize top risk (latency & integration gaps) + show metric snippet
- 07:00–12:00 propose 90-day plan and dedicated trial (cost/benefit highlight)
- 12:00–18:00 identify stakeholders, blockers, and internal owners
- 18:00–22:00 agree next steps + meeting cadence + exec review date
- 22:00–25:00 quick Qs, close

Talking points / scripts:
- Opener (AE): "We saw two recent degradations that materially affect Kenji's team. I want to align with Marcus on a short remediation plan so we don’t hit the renewal conversation unprepared."
- Reassurance (CSM): "We're proposing a 4-week dedicated capacity trial with a monitoring playbook — if we hit X% improvement in 95th latency, we fold that into renewal terms."
- Cost framing: "Trial estimated incremental $4.5k for 4 weeks; we believe cost is offset by reduced ops hours and improved throughput, and we can gate continuation on metrics."

Risk flags to surface (notes to self):
- Procurement procurement: Dana will push back on incremental spend. Need a one-line ROI argument and optional credit.
- On-prem integration: Lara’s team has deep change windows; any dedicated trial that touches infra needs her sign-off early.
- Exec attention: VP Eng is time-poor — keep their involvement to two decision points (trial approval + post-trial review).

Operational checklist (actions to complete before the meeting):
- Pull last 14 days of latency traces + a 1-page screenshot (owner: Marcus) — due before meeting.
- Confirm SRE availability for a follow-up 30-min deep-dive (owner: Avery) — pinged, awaiting reply.
- Prepare a one-slide cost/benefit (owner: AE) — include run-rate delta and priority KPIs.
- Draft proposed trial config (GPU size, model variant, traffic split) — ask infra for feasibility (owner: Marcus / ask infra via GH PR).

Potential asks to AE during meeting:
- Can you commit to a one-page executive email to Dana endorsing the trial? (helps unblock procurement)
- Will AE share any recent customer anecdotes about failures to highlight business impact?

If Dana pushes back — fallback options: 
- Offer a pilot credit (60% credit for first 2 weeks) to remove procurement friction.
- Propose a staged trial with lower-cost model variant and conservative traffic ramp.

Post-meeting deliverables (template actions):
- 1-day: send summary email with agreed scope, owners, dates, success metrics (owner: Marcus)
- 3 days: schedule dedicated 4-week trial start + assign tracking dashboard (owner: Avery)
- 7 days: provide trial runbook + escalation contacts (owner: Marcus + SRE)
- 30 days (mid-trial): checkpoint metric digest to Dana + VP Eng (owner: AE)
- 45 days (end of trial): outcome review and renewal implications (owners: AE + Marcus)

Unresolved questions (to surface):
- Is there contractual language that prevents a short dedicated trial? (check Legal)
- What’s the minimum capacity change needed to see 30% drop in 95th latency? (ask infra)
- Can we fast-track a procurement one-pager? (AE task)

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep the meeting under 25 mins. Executives hate long preambles.
- Bring an explicit metric threshold for "success" (e.g., 95th latency < 420ms AND error rate < 0.3%).
- If we surface a deep SRE root cause, propose a canary with 10% traffic before full trial.

Quick links & refs:
- Incident notes (CS-1227) — link in Confluence (CONFLUENCE:RDW-ANALYTICS-356)
- Prior renewal deck (Nov 2024) — note: includes historical usage trend
- Infra PR on autoscaler tuning (GITHUB:repo/infra#412)

Final line (script for close):
"Appreciate everyone’s time. If we can agree on the 4-week trial and owners, I’ll follow up within 24 hours with a one-page summary and calendar invites."
